notes.title: Update & Sale
notes.notes:
Hello explorers!

For today we have a new update! And whats a better way to celebrate an update then with a 2 week long sale?

Change Log
UI

 Updated the splash screen
 Updates the main menu


Fixed Bugs

 Walls blocking off areas
 Not getting a "Shop level"


If you still havent checked out Seeker of the Ruins be sure to do so!

notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
Hello Explorers!

Been a while :)
I have been busy working on Seeker of the Ruins, so stay tuned for that, and be sure to check it out and try the demo. However, it doesn't mean Cryptic Escape will be forgotten!
So in honor if the Winter sale here is a small but significant update 

Change Log

Fixed Bugs

 Reworked the dungeon creation so no more: Random floor tiles, blocked off areas, odd walls
 (Hopefully) More interesting and dynamic dungeons.
 Monsters getting stuck


Mac & Linux support
Cryptic Escape is now available for mac and linux! (Still no controller support though)

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello explorers!
Hello everyone! A short day after launch and already a few bugs have been reported, glad to say they are all fixed :)
Hope exploration has been kind on all of you, and good luck in future attempts!

Change Log
Fixed Bugs

 Chests stuck in walls
 Monsters not shooting when standing still
 Stairs in 4th floor looking weird
 Monsters spawning ontop of player after using the 'pacman' potion

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Hello Explorers!

I'm super glad to finally announce the full release of Cryptic Escape!
I won't go through all of the changes, enjoy finding them out by yourselves ːsteamhappyː But i will say that there are 4 new floors, each with different, harder enemies. So good luck explorers! Go find that treasure

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.notes:
Hello explorers!
Only a small patch for today, due to feedback from the next fest :)
Reminder that the best place to leave feedback is over at my discord

Change Log
Tutorial

 Clearer explanation about potions


Bugs

 Finishing a quest doesn't grant proper reward
 Being able to buy the last available skill over and over
 Monsters being able to push over chests
 'Back' button not working in the settings menu


Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.notes:
Hello Explorers! 
Todays update bring a bunch of new features and changes in anticipation for the Steam Next Fest (Im abit late but dont tell anyone). Cant wait for next week full release! 
Reminder for everyone to feel free leaving feedback over at the discord, cant wait to hear what you think of todays update.

Change Log
Tutorial

 Brand new-actually good and explainable tutorial (sorry it took so long)


Gameplay

 Quests
 Removed the stairs to next floor (they will be available in the full game)
 New songs
 Levers to block out hallways
 Traps along the dungeon
 Monsters are slowed down by spikes


Bugs

 Taunt icon and counter not showing
 Game crash when buying all available upgrades
 Player movement
 Game crash on open

notes.title: Update 0.1.3
notes.notes:
Hello explorers!

A busy month behind us, full of work on the full game which will come shortly after steam next fest (Feel free to check out the new trailer for some sneak peeks)!
But for today we have a small update for the demo. Which includes a major mechanic change.

Change log
Mechanics

 You always get gold (even after failed runs)


Sounds

 +Music!
 +Monster sound effects


Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hello Explorers!

Almost a week has passed since the demo's release, and with it ton of feedback! I have worked hard to adjust and update the game accordingly and I hope to live up to the expectations!

Todays update brings a major change to how the compass works, and some minor changes/additions. Remember the best way to leave feedback is in the discord or here, the steam forums. Can't wait to hear what you think of the new compass!


Change Log:
UI

 -Old compass
 +New compass (arrow around the player. Note: the compass points to the general area of the key) 
 +Compass now points to the door aswell (Note: It points to an even more general area)
 +Option to toggle "Auto Press E" on chests/door/key/etc'
 +Custom cursor ːsteamhappyː


Bugs

 Game crash when buying upgrades
 Game crash when all of the upgrades have been bought
 Pathfinding issues


Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey explorers!

A fast small little quality of life update to make the demo release go smoother!

Notes:
[olist]
 Fixed a bug where spikes on top of the player
 Changed abit the tutorial
 Explination panels abit more understandable
[/olist]

If you have any feedback please do let me know either in the discord or at the steam discussions.

Good luck in your explorations!
